name: AWS Accounts
description: What an AWS account scopes (resources, identity, billing), why organisations run many accounts to limit blast radius, and how AWS Organizations groups them.

competencyLevels.descriptor: Can say an account is the container for resources and the bill.
Can explain why dev and prod live in separate accounts and what AWS Organizations adds.
Has worked across multiple accounts using roles rather than shared credentials.
Designs an account structure (OUs, SCPs, landing zone) for an organisation.
